record.context_brief: Approximation scheme positivity of limit minimizer
record.original_question: For the approximating problem -Δu + u^q/(u+ε)^(q+α) = λu^p in Ω with u = 0 on ∂Ω, where ε > 0 and 0 < q < p, if the minimizers u_ε converge as ε → 0 to a nonnegative solution u, is the limit solution u necessarily strictly positive in Ω?

evidence.quote: -Δu + u^q/(u+ε)^(q+α) = λu^p in Ω, u = 0 on ∂Ω.
One can guess that u > 0 and that maybe v has compact support, but this is not proved in the paper.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ be a bounded smooth domain, and let $0 < q < p$, $\alpha > 0$, and $\lambda > 0$ be fixed parameters. For each $\varepsilon > 0$, consider the regularized semilinear elliptic boundary value problem
$$-\Delta u + \frac{u^{q}}{(u+\varepsilon)^{q+\alpha}} = \lambda u^{p} \ \text{in } \Omega, \qquad u = 0 \ \text{on } \partial\Omega,$$
and let $u_\varepsilon \in H_0^1(\Omega)$ denote a nonnegative minimizer of the associated energy functional
$$J_\varepsilon(v) = \frac{1}{2}\int_\Omega |\nabla v|^2\,dx + \int_\Omega F_\varepsilon(v)\,dx - \frac{\lambda}{p+1}\int_\Omega (v^+)^{p+1}\,dx,$$
where $F_\varepsilon$ is the primitive of $s\mapsto s_+^{q}/(s_++\varepsilon)^{q+\alpha}$ vanishing at $0$. Suppose that, along a subsequence $\varepsilon\to 0^+$, the minimizers $u_\varepsilon$ converge to a nonnegative function $u\in H_0^1(\Omega)$ that is a (weak) solution of the limit singular problem
$$-\Delta u + u^{-\alpha}\chi_{\{u>0\}} = \lambda u^{p} \ \text{in } \Omega, \qquad u = 0 \ \text{on } \partial\Omega.$$
Question: Is the limit solution $u$ necessarily strictly positive throughout $\Omega$?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return any source establishing or refuting strict positivity of the limit minimizer for this specific approximation scheme. The question is explicitly stated as not proved in the originating overview, and no subsequent resolution was found in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: Minimal Lp-solutions to singular sublinear elliptic problems
status_evidence.snippet: Studies minimal solutions of singular elliptic problems but does not address the specific positivity question for this approximation scheme.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the strict positivity of the limit minimizer for the stated regularized problem is found.

status_evidence.title: Semilinear elliptic equations with strong singularity
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses minimizers of singular functionals but does not settle whether the limit of u_ε is strictly positive.
status_evidence.claim: Related work does not contain a positivity result for the limit minimizer of the cited approximation.
